list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.

exophase.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)

sources.note: Guide steps are this guide's own reading of the official description. Where the description does not pin down a place or a trigger, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one; nothing here was verified in the game yet.

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (grades and PSN progress counts)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the character finales and stranger strands, then activities and collectibles, and leave 100% completion (A Long Road) for last, since it is the longest grind. Keep the two missable trophies (Catch Me If You Can, Capital Offense) in mind from the start so a single playthrough can cover everything.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. This is the first story mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally as the story opens and cannot be missed. If you are starting fresh, just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen appears.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock from story progress alone — play the missions in the order the game presents them and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from story progress only, so keep playing the main missions in order. Use the time in this chapter to start chipping at the long counters (stunts, vehicles discovered, areas explored) while you travel between missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Story progress only — the trophy pops when the chapter closes. By this point the map is well opened up, so it is a good moment to clear a few activity trophies (drone races, fishing, arcade) between missions instead of leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Story progress only — the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you push into the finale, check the missables page: Capital Offense (smash out of a vehicle showroom) belongs to a story moment, so make a manual save before showroom missions from here on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This gold trophy is the story's endpoint and cannot be missed — finish Chapter 4 and play the finale to its end. After it pops, the game opens up for clean-up: side strands, collectibles and the 100% completion push toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. It is a main-story mission, so it unlocks by playing the story in order and cannot be missed. Follow the mission objectives as the game presents them.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so work through any prep the game asks for, then run the heist itself to completion. Story progress only — it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears. It is a main-story mission, so it comes from playing the story in order and cannot be missed. Follow the objectives the game gives you in the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a main-story mission, unlocked by playing the story in order, and it cannot be missed. Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport mission at VCIA. This is the mission to pair with the missable trophy Catch Me If You Can: before you finish the mission the normal way, make an unscheduled departure from the airport (take a plane or drive out on your own terms) and keep a manual save from before the mission starts, in case the moment only comes once. The trophy itself pops when the mission is complete.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main-story mission, unlocked by playing the story in order, and it cannot be missed. Follow the mission objectives through to completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own stats screen — the last big gold on the road to platinum. It takes the story plus everything countable: side strands, activities, collectibles and the long counters (stunts, vehicles, areas, challenges). Do it last, after every other trophy: open the in-game 100% checklist, work down whatever categories are still short, and use this guide's roadmap stages to find which trophies feed each category.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, airtime, near-misses and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. PSN tracks the count to 250. The cheapest way is to fold it into normal play: take jumps and ramps whenever you travel, and chain stunt opportunities on long drives instead of fast-travelling. It is a grind, not a skill gate, so it finishes on its own over a full playthrough if you drive boldly.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one taste of everything the game offers (races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest of the activities menu). PSN tracks the count to 9. Open the activities list, work down it one by one, and the trophy pops on the ninth type. A good early-game trophy: it teaches you where everything is.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks the count to 42. Go to a shooting range, work through the challenge list weapon by weapon, and replay any challenge that lands silver or bronze until it turns gold — accuracy and speed both matter, so learn each challenge's target pattern before rushing it. This is the single biggest activity grind in the list, so spread it across the playthrough rather than doing all 42 in one sitting.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations — one win per location, not 14 wins at one spot. PSN tracks the count to 14. Visit each Top Fun spot on the map, win its race, and move on; learn each course's racing line on a practice run first if you keep losing by a second or two. Tick locations off in this guide's tracker as you win them so you can see which ones are left.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters: replaying the same race 20 times does not count. PSN tracks the count to 20. Work through the race list across Leonida (street races, off-road and any other race type the game offers), winning each event once, and keep a note of which events you have already won. Pair it with the drone races and the shooting range for an activities session.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him — watch the line tension and the fish's runs rather than reeling flat-out, and retry the challenge if he edges you on the first attempt. One win is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one arcade game through to its end, whatever game it is. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game, and finish it; a high score is not needed, only a completed run. A quick early trophy that also counts toward trying every activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Follow Andy's missions as they appear until his storyline closes with its last mission — the trophy pops on completion. Character strands are side content, so check your mission list between story chapters if his missions stop appearing.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Play Kenton's missions in order until his storyline closes with its last mission. Character strands are side content, so pick his missions up between story chapters if they stop appearing on their own.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Play Billy's missions in order until his storyline closes with its last mission. Like the other character finales, it is side content — check the mission list between story chapters if his strand goes quiet.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the Strangers & Freaks side missions. PSN tracks the count to 8. Strangers appear as markers around the map; take each one's missions and follow the strand to its end. Explore off the main roads and check new areas as the map opens, since strands are scattered across the whole state, not just Vice City.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Play Randy's missions in order until his storyline closes with its last mission. Character strands are side content — check your mission list between story chapters if his missions stop appearing.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Play Tyrone's missions in order until his storyline closes with its last mission. Character strands are side content, so pick his missions up between story chapters if they stop appearing on their own.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 18. Spots are scattered around the state, often at scenic or quiet places — visit each one, sit down and meditate until the game registers it, then move on. Tick them off in this guide's tracker as you go, since the last one or two are the ones that take the hunting.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow Bret's hunting strand until he marks the unique animal, track it, and take it down — approach carefully and use a weapon that keeps the kill clean rather than scaring it off. One unique animal, one trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — find the cards hidden around Leonida and finish any three full sets. Cards are a collectible hunt: pick them up as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are close to complete, then hunt the missing cards for those sets first. You do not need every card in the game, only three finished sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 100. WAiNK spots are spread over the whole map, so make it a habit: whenever you arrive somewhere new, WAiNK It before you leave. It is a long count, so start early and let it build up over the playthrough instead of saving all 100 for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. PSN tracks the count to 50. Challenges cover the game's side goals — driving, shooting, exploration and more — so just play broadly and the count climbs: try new activities, chase the challenge lists in the menu, and mop up the stragglers late in the game by picking the quickest unfinished challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose it and escape. Get the heat up with your partner in the car or on foot, then break line of sight, hide until the stars drain, and get clear — the trophy pops once you are free. Pick a spot with alleys or countryside to hide in, and do not get busted or wasted mid-escape or the attempt resets.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. Hit one shop, keep the heat alive, drive straight to the next shop and rob it, then a third — the trick is staying wanted the whole chain, so do not hide long enough to lose the stars and do not get busted. Plan a route with three close shops before you start, and keep your partner with you for all three.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in and drive (or at least find) 100 distinct vehicles across Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 100. Variety is the point: try every car, bike, boat and aircraft type you come across instead of sticking to one favourite, and check car parks, docks and airfields for models you have not driven yet. It builds up naturally if you keep swapping rides.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with five or more enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it runs out — pick a mission or shootout where enemies group up, and do not waste the focus on one or two stragglers. If you only get four, reload and try the same fight again.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Instead of leaving through the scripted exit, get out on your own terms: grab a plane and take off, or drive out of the airport grounds yourself. Do it around the VCIA Takedown story mission, and make a manual save before that mission starts — the description reads like a one-chance story moment, and if you finish the airport section the normal way first, the departure may not come again. This is one of only two missable trophies in the game, so do not put it off.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a quip, not instructions: it points at the Rhino tank. Expect a sequence where Rhinos (tanks) show up — deal with them on the game's terms, using heavy weapons, cover and the objectives the mission gives you, and the trophy should pop from that encounter. The official list does not pin down which mission or moment it is, so this guide does not invent one: when tanks appear, fight them and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth job. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and witnesses, do not raise an alarm, and get out before anyone spots you. If you are detected, the attempt is blown — reload a save from before the robbery and try a quieter approach rather than shooting your way out, since a loud exit will not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. PSN tracks the count to 5. Plan each vault like a heist: get in, crack the vault, grab the take and escape clean — the escape counts, so a vault robbed but a getaway failed does not move the count. Space them out across the playthrough and bring a fast getaway vehicle.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and get away clean — the escape counts, so do not stop fighting once you have the money: break away, lose any wanted level, and reach safety. Pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit so the getaway is short.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole state, not just Vice City. PSN tracks the count to 52. The map fills in as you travel, so drive and fly through every region: the countryside, the coast, the swamps and the small towns, not just the city streets. Near the end, check which areas are still unvisited on the map and make a tour of the gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 9. Illegal operations are gang-run spots around the map — hit one per gang, and keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed so you do not waste time repeating one. The gangs are spread across the state, so this pairs well with exploring all 52 areas.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge: walk the beachfront until you find the right spot, order the cocktail and let the scene play. A good palate-cleanser between heists.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. When a story moment puts you inside a vehicle showroom, do not walk out: get in a car and drive straight through the front — glass, doors and all — the way the old getaway scenes play it. Make a manual save before any mission that takes you into a showroom, because the description reads like a one-chance story beat, and a quiet exit first may mean the moment never comes again. This is one of only two missable trophies in the game, so treat every showroom visit as the one.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through a game there. Go to that alley, start a game of bowling and play it to its end — a good score is not required, only a finished game at that specific alley. It also counts toward trying every activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is a riddle, not instructions: it points at a partnership moment that plays to a crowd. Play through the partner beats of the story and the partner activities — the trophy comes from a scene with your partner, not from a grind. The official list does not pin down which moment it is, so this guide does not invent one: keep playing the partner content and it will pop from the scene itself.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. Choices accumulate across the whole game: dialogue picks, story decisions and the small either-or moments of missions and side content. There is no single choice to hunt; just play, pick an option whenever the game offers one instead of walking past it, and the count climbs toward 500 over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt: fail something once, then succeed on the retry. If a mission or activity beats you the first time, go straight back in and clear it on the second try — the trophy reads like it pops from that comeback. The official list does not name the event, so this guide does not invent one: retry what you fail and the second-time success is the trigger to watch for.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description is a reaction, not instructions: something strange happens and the trophy pops when you witness it. Expect an odd, unexplained encounter out in the world — the kind of easter-egg moment the series hides off the beaten path. Explore strange spots, check out anything that looks out of place, and when something weird happens, the trophy is the reward for being there to see it. The official list does not say where it is, so this guide does not invent a location.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Get a vehicle moving, pull alongside someone on foot, and swing a melee weapon as you pass so the hit lands while you are still driving. Speed and timing matter more than force: line the pass up first, then strike as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts and clean them until the laundered total reaches $250,000. PSN tracks the count to $250,000. It is a money grind, so keep laundering after every big score instead of letting marked bills pile up — the total builds steadily across the playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Any shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles — so just buy what you need as you play and the total climbs; PSN tracks it to $100,000. If you reach the endgame short of the mark, spend the leftover on a big-ticket item (a vehicle or a weapon) to close the gap in one purchase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 8. Garages are bought with in-game money, so save up and purchase them as they become available — check the property listings as new areas open, and buy each garage when you can afford it rather than saving all eight for the endgame.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you want to keep, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — PSN tracks the count to 10. Use a mix of cars and bikes you come across while playing, and register them as you go instead of hunting ten at once at the end.
trophies.name: On the Spot
